name: SNT Motiv Co., Ltd.
summary: SNT Motiv Co., Ltd. engages in the production, development, and sale of products for defense and automotive industries in South Korea and internationally. The company offers motors, engine/transmission components, chassis, airbags, power train parts, shock absorbers; semiconductor machinery components; and defense products, as well as suspension modules, wheels and tires, and knuckles. It also provides electric/electronic products, such as vehicle information display, driving/parking assistance system, vehicle entertainment system, body control.
